transcript.text:
Thank you all for flagging these issues. Let me summarize what I'm hearing so we can build the corrected final package:

1. From Julian (standards): Minimum voter age of 13, exactly one vote per verified account, and voting closes at 9:50 PM Eastern — all binding and must be incorporated.

2. From Nia (platform): SMS integration failed certification this morning — only the web portal passed. So we need to drop SMS as a voting channel. The portal also requires account verification before accepting a vote.

3. From Leon (rights): The label's written approval allows finalist names and approved headshots only — no performance audio or video. The current draft interface still has performance clips, which must be removed.

4. From Sofia (data protection): Participation must be limited to viewers physically located in the United States and Canada — not worldwide as the draft currently states. And voter identifiers must be deleted within 30 days — a retention/deletion step needs to be added.

So the final voting package would be: web portal only (no SMS), minimum age 13, one vote per verified account, account verification required, voting closes at 9:50 PM Eastern, eligible territories are the US and Canada only, interface may show finalist names and approved headshots only (no performance audio/video), and voter identifiers deleted within 30 days.

Does anyone have any objections or additional concerns before I lock this in as the final binding decision?
